headline: Piedmont Peaks and Lakeside Retreats
reservation: State park entry is generally open, but popular areas like Crowders Mountain may implement parking closures when lots are full. Glamping and specialized accommodations require individual booking months in advance; check official park pages for any new permit requirements.

days.title: Foothill Heights

stops.name: Crowders Mountain State Park
stops.detail: Hike the rugged trails to the summit for views spanning from the Piedmont to the Blue Ridge.

stops.name: Daniel Stowe Botanical Garden
stops.detail: Stroll through manicured landscapes and conservatories showcasing the region's diverse flora.

days.driving: Allow 1 hour; check for weekend morning parking delays at Crowders.
days.note: Crowders Mountain parking frequently reaches capacity by mid-morning on weekends.

days.title: River and Rapids

stops.name: U.S. National Whitewater Center
stops.detail: Engage in rafting, kayaking, or trail running on the banks of the Catawba River.

stops.name: Latta Nature Preserve
stops.detail: Explore quiet forest trails and view the shores of Mountain Island Lake.

days.driving: Allow 45 minutes; conditions vary based on local traffic.
days.note: Whitewater activities are seasonal; check the official calendar for winter closures.

days.title: Lakeside Culture

stops.name: Lake Norman State Park
stops.detail: Enjoy the swimming beach or explore the extensive mountain biking trail system.

stops.name: Davidson College Arboretum
stops.detail: Walk the historic campus and its diverse collection of trees and shrubs.

days.driving: Allow 1 hour; weekend traffic near Lake Norman can be heavy.
days.note: Boat rentals at Lake Norman should be arranged in advance during summer months.

intel.title: Park Lot Capacity
intel.text: Crowders Mountain lots fill extremely early during spring and fall weekends. Alternative parking for the Whitewater Center may require a short walk to the main gates.

intel.title: Foothill Reception
intel.text: Service is reliable in Uptown and suburban hubs like Concord. Expect intermittent signal loss in the deeper valleys of the Uwharrie National Forest.

intel.title: Piedmont Logistics
intel.text: Gas stations are plentiful in Gastonia and Rock Hill before you head into rural parklands. Check fuel levels if driving deeper into the foothills toward the South Mountains.

intel.title: Seasonal Foliage
intel.text: Peak autumn colors typically occur in late October or early November in the city. Spring blooms like dogwoods usually appear between late March and mid-April.

intel.title: Trail Surface Info
intel.text: Most city greenways are paved and accessible for all users. Mountain trails at Crowders feature steep, rocky sections that require careful footing.

plan.arrival: Collect vehicle at CLT airport and transit 20 minutes to Uptown; stop in Gastonia for hiking supplies.
plan.vehicle: Standard cars are sufficient for most areas; consider high-clearance if exploring rural fire roads in Uwharrie.
plan.goldenHour: King's Pinnacle overlook for sunset; bring a headlamp for the descent after dark.
